title: 第8章  这个是另外的价钱
slug: 我一杂役怎么成掌门孩子他爹了
content_zh:
“……”
看着躺在床上的叶长天，月青霜俏脸顿时刷地一下就红了。
虽说她是在师尊的指引下，主动来找叶长天双修，可这二十年来一直跟着师尊修行，从未与任何男子有过亲密接触。
真到了这一步，对她来说还是有些难为情的。
更何况……
这事师尊也没教过她。
怎么开始她好像也不会啊。
“我还没做好准备，等我做好准备才开始吧。”
月青霜红着脸道。
虽说她对叶长天的感官不差，但今天毕竟还是第一次见面，就这么开始双修还是有点难为情的。
还是培养培养感情再双修成为道侣吧。
“行吧。”
叶长天点了点头。
反正他就是个拿钱办事的。
金主爸爸的要求，自然要尽可能地满足才行。
他从床榻上坐了起来，笑着道：“圣女大人没有其它事情的话，我就继续修炼了。”
叶长天就再次将注意力集中在阴阳造化界。
月青霜刚才给他的一万灵石，又凝聚出了一些阴阳之力。
叶长天毫不犹豫地分出了一半阴阳之力，直接将修为提升至炼气九层巅峰。
“……”

见得叶长天修为又刷刷地提升了两个小境界，一旁的月青霜人都麻了。
修炼突破就跟吃饭喝水一样简单，你特么告诉这是伪灵根的杂役弟子？
谁家杂役弟子比她这个天品灵根的圣女还离谱啊？
“只差一步就能破境筑基了！”
感受到自己的修为，叶长天双眼中不由闪过一道凌厉的精芒。
在玄黄大世界。
灵根天赋越好的修行者，破境就越容易。
比如月青霜这等天品灵根的造孽，不需借助任何外力就能轻松破境筑基。
一些普通灵根的人，则需要用提升筑基概率的筑基丹辅助。
而像叶长天这等伪灵根的废材，想要破境更是难如登天。
不过……
对于如今的叶长天来说，倒也并非不能解决。
丹药分为下品，中品，上品，极品，完美等品质。
一枚下品筑基丹可以提升三成的筑基概率，极品筑基丹甚至可以提升七成！
而传说中的完美品质，据说可以让任何修行者百分百筑基成功！
完美品质的丹药世间罕见，可遇而不可求。
但叶长天拥有阴阳造化界。
哪怕给他一枚残品的筑基丹，他也能将其变成完美品质的丹药！
“看来得想办法弄一枚筑基丹了。”
叶长天目光微微闪烁。

杂役弟子想要弄到筑基丹，几乎不太可能。
而宋浩又不会让他轻易晋升外门弟子。
唯一的办法，就是去给炼丹师打杂，或许能有希望弄枚残品筑基丹。
只要筑基成功，哪怕宋浩那位炼气九层的老爹，他也能将其按在地上摩擦！
“圣女大人，我要去找点杂役活干，你要跟我一起吗？”
叶长天抬头看了月青霜一眼，笑着问道。
“长天师兄，你还是叫我青霜师妹吧。”
月青霜摇头道：“我就不去了。”
她在内门有一位关系极好的师姐，这位师姐早就有了道侣。
月青霜觉得有必要像师姐请教一下双修的事情。
叶长天闻言，也没多说什么。
他走出房间，就见得一位杂役峰执事大步朝他走来。
“叶长天，离火宫炼丹大师需要一名杂役弟子，上面点名让你去，这是令牌。”
叶长天眼眸微眯。
离火宫，太玄宗炼丹大师火凤儿的住处。
传闻火凤儿丹道无双，容颜绝世，但性情却极为古怪，是令无数杂役弟子闻风丧胆的魔鬼炼丹师。
每一位前往离火宫打杂的杂役弟子，都会被折磨得惨不忍睹，几乎不成人样，即便修养个十天半个月都难以缓过来。
叶长天不用想都知道。
让他去离火宫打杂，多半是宋浩那家伙的手笔。
这是要借火凤儿的手来搞他啊。

不过……
叶长天本来就想找个给炼丹师打杂的活。
宋浩此举，无疑是瞌睡来了送枕头。
不就是去离火宫打杂而已。
难道那火凤儿还能吃了他不成？
叶长天接过令牌，径直朝着离火宫的方向而去。
来到离火宫，叶长天出示了令牌，就在一位仆人的带领下进入了一间丹房。
丹房内。
一位身着火红色长裙的女子静静地盘腿坐在丹炉旁。
女子看上去约么二十五六的年纪，一双迷人的丹凤眼，五官精致，火红色长裙也难以掩盖那成熟火爆的身躯。
望着丹房中的女子，叶长天只能用八个字来形容。
波涛汹涌，有容乃大！
毫无疑问，眼前这个女人，就是太玄宗那位魔鬼炼丹师火凤儿了。
此时此刻。
火凤儿仿佛根本没有注意到走进丹房的叶长天，美眸一动不动地盯着手中的丹方。
这丹方看上去极为泛黄古老。
在岁月的洗礼下，丹方上甚至有一些字迹都已经变得模糊不清。
这应该是一张上古残方。
火凤儿显然是在推演这张上古残方，试图将其补全。
“火大师，杂役峰叶长天前来报道。”

叶长天来到火凤儿身旁，恭恭敬敬地对着火凤儿行了一礼。
火凤儿抬头瞥了叶长天，淡淡道：“把衣服脱了，躺好吧。”
“？？？”
叶长天听得一脸懵逼。
一进门就让他脱衣服躺好？
这火凤儿究竟闹哪样？
不会也馋他的身子吧？
“火大师，这不太好吧，我卖艺不卖身的。”
叶长天说完，又弱弱地补充了一句：“当然，卖身也不是不行，这个是另外的价钱！”
“咯咯……”
“小弟弟，虽然你长得挺好看，但也不要想得太美。”
火凤儿对着叶长天妩媚一笑：“姐姐炼丹需要用血做药引，来姐姐这里打杂其实很简单，只需乖乖躺好让我抽血就行了。”
“……”
叶长天人都麻了。
他总算明白，为何来给火凤儿打杂的杂役弟子都要扶着墙出来。
原来是被火凤儿给抽干了。
“火姐姐，你抽血做药引，不会是想要炼制这上古残方上的丹药吧？”
叶长天顿时露出了一个比苦还难看的笑容。
“没错，这段时间我已经抽了三十三位杂役弟子的血炼丹，结果都失败了。”
火凤儿美眸在叶长天身上一扫，两眼放光地道：“小弟弟，你比以前那些杂役弟子强多了，先让我来一发吧。”
content_en:
"..."
Looking at Ye Changtian lying on the bed, Yue Qingshuang's pretty face suddenly turned red.
Although she took the initiative to come to Ye Changtian for dual cultivation under the guidance of her master, she had been practicing with her master for the past twenty years and had never had close contact with any man.
It was still a bit embarrassing for her to have come to this point.
What's more...
Master didn't teach her this either.
She didn't seem to know how to do it at first.
"I'm not ready yet. Let's start when I am."
Yue Qingshuang said with a red face.
Although her feelings for Ye Changtian were not bad, it was still the first time they met today, so it was a bit embarrassing to start dual cultivation like this.
It’s better to cultivate relationships and then practice dual cultivation to become a Taoist couple.
"Okay."
Ye Changtian nodded.
After all, he is just paid to do things.
Naturally, the request of the sponsor’s father must be met as much as possible.
He sat up from the bed and said with a smile: "If the Holy Lady has nothing else to do, I will continue to practice."
Ye Changtian once again focused his attention on the Yin and Yang world of creation.
The ten thousand spirit stones that Yue Qingshuang gave him just now condensed some yin and yang power.
Ye Changtian did not hesitate to use half of his yin and yang power, directly raising his cultivation level to the peak of the ninth level of Qi refining.
"..."
Seeing that Ye Changtian's cultivation level has been improved by two small realms, the people on the side of Yue Qingshuang were numb.
Cultivating a breakthrough is as simple as eating and drinking. Why the hell are you telling this to be a handyman disciple with fake spiritual roots?
Which handyman disciple is more outrageous than her, a saint with heavenly spiritual roots?
"It's just one step away from breaking through and building a foundation!"
Feeling his own cultivation, Ye Changtian couldn't help but flash a sharp light in his eyes.
In the big world of Xuanhuang.
The better the spiritual root talent of the practitioner, the easier it will be to break through the realm.
For example, those with heavenly spiritual roots like Yue Qingshuang can easily break through and build foundations without any external force.
Some people with ordinary spiritual roots need the assistance of foundation-building pills that increase the probability of foundation-building.
And for waste materials with pseudo-spiritual roots like Ye Changtian, it is even more difficult to break through.
But...
For today's Ye Changtian, it is not impossible to solve it.
Pills are divided into low-grade, medium-grade, top-grade, top-grade, perfect and other qualities.
A low-grade foundation-building pill can increase the probability of foundation-building by 30%, and a top-grade foundation-building pill can even increase it by 70%!
And the legendary perfect quality is said to allow any practitioner to achieve 100% success in foundation building!
Perfect quality elixirs are rare in the world and can only be found but not sought.
But Ye Changtian possesses the Yin and Yang world of creation.
Even if you give him a broken Foundation Establishment Pill, he can turn it into a perfect quality pill!
"Looks like we have to find a way to get a foundation-building pill."
Ye Changtian's eyes flickered slightly.
It is almost impossible for the handyman disciples to obtain the Foundation Establishment Pill.
And Song Hao would not let him be easily promoted to an outer disciple.
The only way is to work for the alchemist, and maybe there is hope of getting a residual foundation-building pill.
As long as the foundation building is successful, even Song Hao's father, who is at the ninth level of Qi refining, can press him to the ground and rub him!
"Lady Saint, I'm going to find some handyman work. Do you want to come with me?"
Ye Changtian looked up at Yue Qingshuang and asked with a smile.
"Senior Brother Changtian, you should call me Junior Sister Qingshuang."
Yue Qingshuang shook her head and said, "I won't go."
She has a very close senior sister in the inner sect, and this senior sister has already had a Taoist companion.
Yue Qingshuang felt that it was necessary to ask her senior sister about dual cultivation.
When Ye Changtian heard this, he didn't say much.
When he walked out of the room, he saw a handyman named Deacon striding towards him.
"Ye Changtian, the alchemy master of Lihuo Palace needs a handyman disciple. You have been named above to go. This is the token."
Ye Changtian's eyes narrowed slightly.
Lihuo Palace is the residence of Huo Feng'er, Taixuanzong's alchemy master.
It is said that Huo Feng'er has unparalleled alchemy skills and a peerless appearance, but her temperament is extremely ancient.Strange, he is a devil alchemist who makes countless handyman disciples fearful of him.
Every handyman disciple who goes to the Lihuo Palace to do odd jobs will be tortured so terribly that they are almost transformed into human beings. Even if they train for ten days and a half, they will not be able to recover.
Ye Changtian knew it all without thinking.
It was probably Song Hao's idea to let him go to Lihuo Palace to do odd jobs.
This is to use Huo Feng'er's hand to get rid of him.
But...
Ye Changtian originally wanted to find a job doing odd jobs for an alchemist.
Song Hao's move was undoubtedly a gift of pillows when he felt sleepy.
Isn't it just to go to Lihuo Palace to do odd jobs?
Could it be that Huo Feng'er could still eat him?
Ye Changtian took the token and headed straight towards Lihuo Palace.
Arriving at Lihuo Palace, Ye Changtian showed his token and entered an alchemy room under the leadership of a servant.
In the alchemy room.
A woman in a fiery red dress sat quietly cross-legged next to the alchemy furnace.
The woman looked to be in her mid-twenties, with a pair of charming phoenix eyes, delicate facial features, and a fiery red dress that could not hide her mature and fiery body.
Looking at the woman in the alchemy room, Ye Changtian could only use eight words to describe her.
The waves are turbulent, but tolerance is great!
There is no doubt that the woman in front of him is Huo Feng'er, the devil alchemist of Taixuan Sect.
At this moment.
Huo Feng'er didn't seem to notice Ye Changtian walking into the alchemy room at all, his beautiful eyes staring motionlessly at the alchemy in his hand.
This recipe looks extremely yellow and ancient.
Under the baptism of time, even some of the writing on the prescription has become blurred.
This should be an ancient remnant recipe.
Huo Feng'er was obviously deducing this ancient residual recipe and trying to complete it.
"Master Huo, handyman Feng Ye Changtian is here to report."
Ye Changtian came to Huo Feng'er and bowed to Huo Feng'er respectfully.
Huo Feng'er raised his head and glanced at Ye Changtian, and said calmly: "Take off your clothes and lie down."
"???"
Ye Changtian was confused when he heard this.
As soon as he enters the door, let him take off his clothes and lie down?
What's going on with this Huo Feng'er?
Aren't you also greedy for his body?
"Master Huo, this is not good. I don't sell my skills but my body."
After Ye Changtian finished speaking, he added weakly: "Of course, selling yourself is not impossible, this is a different price!"
"Giggle..."
"Little brother, although you are quite good-looking, don't think too much about your beauty."
Huo Feng'er smiled charmingly at Ye Changtian: "My sister needs blood to make elixirs. It's actually very simple to come to my sister's place to do odd jobs. You just need to lie down and let me draw blood."
"..."
Ye Changtian was numb.
He finally understood why the handyman disciples who came to do chores for Huo Feng'er all came out holding on to the wall.
It turned out that he was drained by Huo Feng'er.
"Sister Huo, are you drawing blood to make medicine to refine the elixir from this ancient remnant recipe?"
Ye Changtian suddenly showed a smile that was uglier than bitter.
"Yes, during this period I have drawn the blood of thirty-three servant disciples to make elixirs, but they all failed."
Huo Feng'er's beautiful eyes glanced at Ye Changtian and said with bright eyes: "Little brother, you are much better than those handyman disciples before. Let me take a shot first."
